_comment: Central model roster for subtitle-live. kind: text-mt = translates subtitle lines; speech = needs audio input (audio mode only). status: ready | staged | broken | watch. subctl /mt only accepts kind=text-mt && status=ready.

models.label: Strata qwen3.8-flash (:8080)
models.note: agent engine; best quality + context; 0.3-0.5 s/line; no extra VRAM

models.label: Qwen3-1.7B Q4_K_M
models.note: llama.cpp :8096; ~0.05 s/line warm; flexes 5 GB from Strata

models.label: madlad400-3b-mt
models.note: 2024 GGUF conversion fails to load in current llama.cpp; reconvert before use

models.label: Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M
models.note: measured 2026-10-30 (mtbench.py, 12 real cues): EN 1 error/12 (best local), IT 5/12 - WORSE than qwen3-4b (le polizie, il libreria da sola). Needs 5 GB disk + 9.7 GB flex window. Deleted to save disk; re-download unsloth/Qwen3-8B-GGUF if wanted.

models.label: Gemma 3 4B IT Q4_K_M
models.note: measured same bench: EN 3/12 (drifts on fragments: versichert->alright), IT 4/12 (stutters: si si chiama; Prima, prima). Emits curly quotes. Not adopted; deleted.

models.label: LLaMA 3.1/3.3 8B Instruct
models.note: HF 401: Llama Community License must be accepted (no agent token). English-centric family, weakest of the class for DE->IT; not pursued.

models.label: Microsoft Phi-4 / Phi-4-mini
models.note: HF 401 without license acceptance. Phi line is English-centric (only Phi-3.5-multilingual is a translation candidate) - wrong tool for DE->IT dubs.

models.label: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B-A4B NVFP4
models.note: audio mode ONLY (ASR + direct speech->text translation, de->en BLEU ~40). Needs vLLM 0.32 + NeMo Speech plugin, ~27 GB VRAM: STOP STRATA FIRST (this agent goes offline). Serve: ./nemotron_serve.sh

models.label: Hy-SimulMT 30B-A3B (Tencent)
models.note: simultaneous speech-to-speech zh<->en ONLY - no German/Italian path, not usable here. GGUF exists but llama.cpp support not merged upstream (repo says wait). Re-check if language coverage grows.

models.label: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime 2602 (Mistral)
models.note: AUDIO mode ASR upgrade: natively streaming causal audio encoder, configurable 240 ms-2.4 s delay, 13 languages incl. de/it, Apache-2.0, ungated, runs >12.5 tok/s on modest hardware (4B). Same family LM Studio uses for Voice Input. Not downloaded.

models.label: Gemini 3.5 LiveTranslate (Google)
models.note: cloud API only (Gemini Live API), no weights. Top FLEURS score but those benchmark rows are zh<->en live interpretation. Usable only for AUDIO mode with an API key + network latency; cue mode needs no speech translation. Would be a remote-mt roster backend if you supply a key.

models.label: Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate (Alibaba)
models.note: no open weights on HF (searched 2026-10-30). The text backbone family (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) is what Strata serves as the agent itself - our local chain already covers its text half. Live/audio variant unpublished; re-check later.
